q1_issues.issue: Two contradictory Cardinality atoms (14500000 at statement 8 and 10400000 here) are asserted of the same group symbol sk_group_1, so the KB holds one group with two sizes and neither count is tied to its month.
The Patient of the drop is the group of people, but the sentence says the NUMBER of people dropped, not that the people themselves fell.
Start/End reinterpret the value range 'from 14.5 million ... to 10.4 million' as a temporal extent of the dropping event, whereas April and June are the times at which each value held.
'The NPD Group' gets its Name atom but no kind atom, although the kind word sits inside the name (the Kestrel River rule requires (Member the_npd_group group)).

q2_gaps: a count or measure CHANGING from one value to another over time ('dropped from 14.5 million in April to 10.4 million in June') — nothing licenses time-indexing a Cardinality/Measure or recording a from-value/to-value transition

evidential attribution 'According to X, P' — the instruction set covers impersonal reported attitudes ('is said to be') but not a source-attribution frame, so the reported proposition is asserted as plain fact
notes: AccordingTo is read as licensed under the multi-word preposition-named oblique convention (AcrossTheLaneFrom), but hanging it on the drop event records only a source, not that the whole claim is reported. The reduced-relative 'downloading music' event, the From-of-origin on the research, and the market_research decomposition all follow the instruction set.
